healthy_koshary.title: Healthy Koshary
healthy_koshary.description: A lighter version of the traditional Egyptian koshary made with brown rice and boiled lentils in a light tomato sauce.
instructions: Boil the brown rice, pasta, and lentils separately.
Mix them together in a large bowl.
In a pan, heat olive oil, then add tomato sauce, cumin, and salt.
Let the sauce simmer until slightly thickened.
Serve the koshary in bowls topped with sauce and roasted onions.

molokhia_with_grilled_chicken.title: Molokhia with Grilled Chicken
molokhia_with_grilled_chicken.description: A delicious Egyptian meal combining fiber-rich green molokhia with low-fat grilled chicken.
instructions: Heat the broth until it boils, then add the molokhia and stir gently to combine.
In a small pan, heat olive oil and add garlic and coriander until golden.
Add the sautéed garlic mix to the molokhia and serve with the grilled chicken.

stuffed_zucchini_light.title: Light Stuffed Zucchini
stuffed_zucchini_light.description: Tender zucchini stuffed with brown rice and vegetables, cooked in natural tomato sauce without excess fat.
instructions: Mix the rice with tomatoes, onion, parsley, and mint.
Stuff the zucchinis with the mixture and place them in a pot.
Pour the tomato sauce over them and drizzle with olive oil.
Cook on low heat for 30–40 minutes until tender.

bamia_with_olive_oil.title: Okra with Olive Oil
bamia_with_olive_oil.description: A lighter Egyptian-style okra stew made with olive oil instead of ghee and fresh tomatoes.
instructions: In a pot, heat olive oil and sauté onion and garlic until soft.
Add tomatoes, okra, and seasonings.
Simmer on low heat for 30 minutes until the sauce thickens and okra is cooked.

grilled_fish_with_tahini.title: Grilled Fish with Tahini Sauce
grilled_fish_with_tahini.description: Lightly grilled tilapia or sea bream served with a protein-rich tahini sauce full of healthy fats.
ingredients: 2 cleaned tilapia or sea bream fish
instructions: Season the fish with garlic, salt, cumin, and olive oil.
Grill in the oven or air fryer until cooked through.
Mix the tahini sauce ingredients until smooth.
Serve the grilled fish topped with tahini sauce.

light_lentil_soup.title: Light Lentil Soup
light_lentil_soup.description: A classic Egyptian lentil soup prepared in a light, nutritious way — perfect for diet meals and rich in plant protein.
instructions: In a pot, heat olive oil and sauté onion, carrot, and tomato until soft.
Add lentils, water, and spices, then simmer until the lentils are tender.
Blend until smooth and serve hot with a sprinkle of cumin.

light_potato_tagine.title: Light Baked Potato Tagine
light_potato_tagine.description: A healthy version of Egyptian potato tagine using olive oil and chicken breast pieces.
ingredients: Salt, pepper, and cumin to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C.
In a baking dish, layer half of the potatoes, then the chicken and onion, and top with the remaining potatoes.
Mix the tomatoes with oil and spices, then pour over the dish.
Cover with foil and bake for 30–35 minutes until cooked through.

diet_grape_leaves.title: Diet Grape Leaves
diet_grape_leaves.description: Light Egyptian-style grape leaves stuffed with brown rice and vegetables, made without butter or meat.
ingredients: Salt and dried mint to taste
instructions: Mix the rice with onion, tomatoes, parsley, and mint.
Stuff the grape leaves and arrange them tightly in a pot.
Mix the broth with lemon juice and olive oil, then pour it over the grape leaves.
Cover and cook on low heat for 40 minutes until fully tender.

diet_tuna_salad.title: Light Tuna Salad
diet_tuna_salad.description: A complete meal rich in protein and omega-3, very filling and perfect for a diet.
instructions: Chop the vegetables.
Add tuna and corn.
Toss with lemon juice, olive oil, and pepper.

diet_vegetable_omelette.title: Baked Vegetable Omelette
diet_vegetable_omelette.description: A healthy alternative to fried eggs, packed with protein and veggies — very filling.
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together.
Pour into a small greased baking dish.
Bake at 180°C until cooked and edges are golden.

diet_baked_potatoes.title: Baked Potatoes with Thyme
diet_baked_potatoes.description: Crispy and very tasty — perfect as a side dish or healthy snack.
instructions: Mix the potatoes with spices and oil.
Bake at 200°C until golden and crispy.

diet_banana_oat_smoothie.title: Banana Oat Smoothie
diet_banana_oat_smoothie.description: A filling, healthy smoothie rich in fiber and potassium — great for breakfast or a snack.
instructions: Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend until smooth and creamy.
Serve cold and add ice cubes if desired.

diet_cottage_cheese_avocado_sandwich.title: Cottage Cheese & Avocado Sandwich
diet_cottage_cheese_avocado_sandwich.description: An excellent source of protein and healthy fats — perfect for breakfast or a light meal.
instructions: Mix the cheese with avocado and seasonings.
Fill the sandwich and serve with sliced veggies or cucumber.

diet_yogurt_cucumber_salad.title: Yogurt Cucumber Mint Salad
diet_yogurt_cucumber_salad.description: Refreshing and very light — perfect as a quick dinner or side dish.
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.
Serve chilled and garnish with mint leaves if desired.

diet_grilled_chicken_lemon.title: Grilled Lemon Chicken Breast
diet_grilled_chicken_lemon.description: A classic healthy meal full of protein and great flavor — ideal for lunch or dinner.
instructions: Marinate the chicken with all ingredients for 15 minutes.
Grill on a nonstick pan or griddle.
Serve with sautéed vegetables or green salad.
